title: Individualized Daily Support Log and Plan
brief: A daily special education support log and behavioral accommodation plan for an elementary student with ASD and sensory sensitivities, drafted from IEP notes and morning classroom data.

slip.document:
# Individualized Daily Support Log and Plan
Ironwood Community Elementary School

## Student Profile
- Student: Dmitri Ferreira
- Grade: 3rd Grade (Room 114)
- Primary Support Paraprofessional: Jamal Kim
- Supervising Case Manager: Ethan Haddad, Ed.S.
- Date: 03/12/2026

## Environmental Triggers and Sensory Profile
| Factor | Assessment / Baseline | Support Strategy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Auditory Overload | Discomfort starts above 65 dB; meltdowns recorded at 80+ dB | Active noise-canceling headphones |
| Tactile Sensitivity | Avoidance of wet textures (glue, clay, finger paint) | Silicone applicator tools, dry vinyl gloves |
| Visual Cues | Requires 3-step PECS visual schedule for class transitions | Visual count-down timer, first-then card |
| Nutritional/Allergy | Severe peanut and tree nut anaphylaxis (EpiPen in health office) | Nut-free classroom zone, designated lunch table |

## Morning Schedule and Routine Notes
- 08:30 AM: Arrival and visual schedule check. Student completed transition from bus with zero prompt resistance.
- 09:15 AM: Reading block. Dmitri completed 15 minutes of guided phonics using token economy board.
- 10:00 AM: All-school assembly in main gymnasium (measured sound level: 84 dB).
- During the gym assembly, keep Dmitri's headphones in his cubby to encourage peer vocalization.
- 11:15 AM: Art class. Ceramic clay sculpting activity.
- Dmitri utilized silicone spatulas and vinyl gloves during clay molding, completing the assigned flower pinch pot.

## Midday Incident and Medical Response Log
- 12:15 PM: Lunch period in the cafeteria.
- Student accidentally picked up a companion tray containing almond butter cookies.
- Dmitri developed facial hives and audible wheezing within two minutes of tasting the cookie.
- Escorted Dmitri to the nurse office immediately; nurse administered epinephrine injection at 12:21 PM.
- 12:25 PM: Notified emergency contacts and dialed 911 dispatch for transport per district emergency medical protocol.

## Afternoon Instructional Plan and Modifications
- 01:15 PM: Science lab on plant biology. Dmitri will work with dry leaf specimens.
- 02:00 PM: Resource room math. Present math problems using the 3-step visual sequence.
- 02:45 PM: Pack backpack, review token rewards earned, and escort to bus loading bay 4.

errors.quote: During the gym assembly, keep Dmitri's headphones in his cubby to encourage peer vocalization.
errors.explanation: The baseline table specifies that Dmitri experiences auditory discomfort above 65 dB and meltdowns at 80+ dB, requiring noise-canceling headphones; withholding them during an 84 dB assembly directly contradicts his sensory accommodation plan.
errors.fix: During the gym assembly, ensure Dmitri wears his active noise-canceling headphones throughout the event.

errors.quote: Escorted Dmitri to the nurse office immediately; nurse administered epinephrine injection at 12:21 PM.
errors.explanation: A student experiencing acute anaphylaxis with breathing difficulty must never be walked or moved to the health office; school emergency medical protocols require the nurse to be summoned to the student immediately while keeping the student seated or recumbent, or administering the EpiPen on site.
errors.fix: Kept Dmitri seated, monitored airway, and summoned the school nurse to the cafeteria immediately; nurse administered epinephrine injection at 12:21 PM.
